searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, and life/PIPELINE.md (applied/closed list: Notion BDR, Stripe New Grad PM Accelerator, Disney APM, Tuck Business Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures APM, TikTok APM, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, Adobe x3, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Google+Capital One calendar hold) -- all excluded regardless of egress state. Re-checked the graduation-date conflict this run's scheduled prompt flagged as 'genuinely unsettled Aug-Dec 2026': life/PROFILE.md reads 'Graduation: December 2026 -- SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md exactly. No live conflict -- the scheduler prompt's framing is stale and should be corrected at the source. Before spending search/fetch budget, tested WebFetch against en.wikipedia.org, www.google.com, www.anthropic.com, and job-board API endpoints (Ashby, Greenhouse) -- all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. A raw curl confirmed a 403 CONNECT-tunnel denial at the proxy for the same domains, while github.com succeeded, so this is a scoped organization allowlist (GitHub/npm/pypi/Anthropic-API-only), not a WebFetch-tool bug or a job-board-specific block. git history of this file shows the identical block reported on every run back through at least 2026-09-01 (one entry traces it to ~2026-08-18). WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible leads (e.g. Anthropic's live 'Applied AI Architect' reqs on Greenhouse), but hunt.md's honesty rules require confirming from the actual fetched page that applications are open and the user is eligible -- impossible while WebFetch is blocked, so no candidate could be verified and none is included. NEW finding this run, not in prior logs: src/hunt-store.js's readHuntResults() returns null whenever opportunities.length is 0 (regardless of searchLog or generatedAt), so this file's honest zero-result explanation never reaches the email -- the send step silently falls through to the paid Anthropic-API opportunity-hunter (src/opportunity-hunter.js, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured in the Actions workflow) and only to Google News if that also fails. That means for the full length of this outage the 'free, subscription-hunt' design intent has likely been quietly replaced by daily paid-API calls with no visible marker in the email -- plausibly related to the '$100/mo Anthropic API spend' flag already logged in life/PIPELINE.md's Watch section (Jul 23). Zero verified opportunities is still the correct, honest output for this file; the real problem is upstream (WebFetch egress allowlist) and downstream (silent fallback with no cost/quality visibility), and both need a human to look at the proxy policy and hunt-store.js's null-on-empty behavior.
